chunks: To God belongs all that is in the heavens and the earth: He may pardon whom He please and punish whom He will. Yet God is forgiving and kind.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that God forgives whom He wills?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the divine attribute of Iradah (Will) as the basis for both forgiveness and punishment, reflecting God's absolute sovereignty over creation. It serves as a bridge between divine justice and mercy, reminding believers that while God has the power to punish, His predominant nature is one of vast forgiveness and compassion.
